props.name: labels
props.description: Visible text and screen reader text, with English defaults. Keys: search, up, down, better, worse, ordersTable, barsHint.

a11y.text: Layout: an aside with nav "Main" (Overview has aria-current="page"), a header with a search field named by aria-label (default "Search orders and products") and a "Notifications, 3 new" button, and main with the h1 "Overview". Below the lg breakpoint the aside is hidden and the same nav, also named "Main", sits in a details menu.

The period switch is a fieldset with a screen-reader-only legend "Period" and native radios; only the chosen period's chart is shown. Each period is its own section named by its h2 ("Revenue, 7 days", "Revenue, 30 days" or "Revenue, 12 months"), so the name follows the chosen period.

Each KPI change reads its direction and verdict in words ("Up 12.4%, better", "Down 0.6%, better" for returns), set through labels. The arrow, sparklines and tooltip dots are aria-hidden. The revenue bars are an ordered list named "Revenue by period, {period}", and each bar holds its value as real text.

Top products are an ordered list. The orders table sits in a focusable scroll region named "Orders table" (labels.ordersTable) so a narrow screen can scroll it by keyboard, and it has column headers; the status dot is aria-hidden and the status is written out. The charts are drawn inline here, not with bar-chart or sparkline.

The period radios and the mobile details menu use native keys. Each revenue chart is one Tab stop. ArrowLeft and ArrowRight move between the bars, Home and End jump to the first and the last, and the active bar shows its tooltip. A hidden hint names the keys (labels.barsHint), and a status line reads the label and value of each bar you move to. The tooltip also shows on hover.
The bars and the share bars grow in and the tooltip scales in with transitions; under reduced motion (motion-reduce) they appear in place without moving.
